title: Climate Change Response Act (氣候變遷因應法)
citation: 氣候變遷因應法 (MOJ database pcode O0020098); 中華民國一百零四年七月一日總統華總一義字第 10400077011 號令
evidence: 沿革 (legislative history) entry 1 on the database page: "中華民國一百零四年七月一日總統華總一義字第 10400077011 號令制 定公布全文 34 條；並自公布日施行". Opened https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawHistory.aspx?pcode=O0020098 on 2026-11-02.
notes: Enacted 2015-07-01 as the Greenhouse Gas Reduction and Management Act (溫室氣體減量及管理法); renamed and re-enacted in full on 2023-02-15 (63 articles, in force on promulgation). The Act has been in force since 2015-07-01 under its old name; the stored text is the current Climate Change Response Act. The earlier Act text is not served by the database, so no record before 2023-02-15. Later Executive Yuan notices only moved functions from the Environmental Protection Administration to the Ministry of Environment (2023-08-22) and do not change the stored text, which still names the Administration in art. 2. Art. 28 and following carry the emissions inventory and carbon fee provisions implemented by tw-carbon-fee-regs. Languages stored on 2026-11-02: zh (official) and en (translation record under TW-MOJ-TRANSLATION; the English page states "Amended Date: 2023-02-15", equal to the Chinese version). English page: https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=O0020098. Only the current consolidated text is served; the database exposes no earlier consolidation and no as-promulgated text, so there is one dated version.
